_doc: The owner's hold on mods in the Maturation Pipeline (mod_owner_hold.py; item RIMMANDRAKE_HOLD_SIX_BIOME_MODS_ONLY_PYRELANDS_STAYS). A mod listed here: the Dispatch tick launches nothing on it, the Designer and DesignerCodex chain sweeps and run-now launches skip it, it raises no stall, idle or incident alarm, and every status names it HELD BY OWNER with his words and date. A run already live on it is allowed to finish. He or the Conductor lifts a hold (owner, by card 2026-11-19: "Conductor should also be able to lift a Hold. We work together, don't use me as a bottleneck alone."): `python3 src/RimMandrake/rimflow/mod_owner_hold.py lift <Mod> --said "<his words>"` (his) or `... lift <Mod> --per-ruling RIMMANDRAKE_ENACT_CONDUCTOR_MAY_LIFT_HOLD_NOT_HIM_ALONE --why "<reason>"` (the Conductor window's, in his daily digest); the control store is the writer and this file its mirror; publish it after. A lifted mod still waits for its readiness list to read READY. Ruling: design/RimMandrake/standing_rulings.md §Owner hold.
